items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: actually John Fedchock does it every year

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s almost like an extreme bass — you know, like extreme sports, but with the bass.

Yeah, yeah. The thing that scares me about Marcus, I did this jazz cruise — actually John Fedchock does it every year. And Marcus has been on it and his band’s unbelievable and he plays a great slap bass solo that’s very melodic. It’s not just hey look what I can do. And he plays great melodies. And then he put the bass down and he picked up the bass clarinet and played “When I Fall in Love.” And I was like now I really don’t like you. I mean I hate when guys can do all that stuff. He plays guitar and keyboard.
Yeah. He pretty much like made Miles records. Like get it all done and then, “okay Miles, come in and play a few notes.”
